book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: بسابع ليلة، قال السندباد: بعد سنة، ناداني الخليفة.
sentences.en: On the seventh night, Sindbad said: after a year, the Caliph called me.

sentences.ar: قال: يا سندباد، بدي أرد على ملك سرنديب.
sentences.en: He said: Sindbad, I want to answer the king of Serendib.
And you are the only one who knows the way.

sentences.ar: قلت: يا أمير المؤمنين، أنا حلفت.
sentences.en: I said: Commander of the Faithful, I swore.
He said: and I am asking.
And no one refuses the Caliph.
So I took his letter and his gift, and went down to Basra.
And I took to the sea, for the seventh time.

sentences.ar: وصلنا سرنديب بسلام، وسلمت المكتوب، وفرح الملك.
sentences.en: We reached Serendib in peace, I delivered the letter, and the king rejoiced.

sentences.ar: وقعدت عنده شهر، وودعته، وركبت السفينة راجع.
sentences.en: And I stayed with him a month, bade him farewell, and boarded the ship home.
And I said: it is done.
The last time.
The way is known, the sea is calm.
And after a week, the pirates came upon us.

sentences.ar: تلات سفن، ورجال بالسيوف، وما قدرنا نعمل إشي.
sentences.en: Three ships, and men with swords, and we could do nothing.
They took the ship, and took us all as slaves.

sentences.ar: باعوني بسوق بمدينة ما بعرف اسمها.
sentences.en: They sold me in a market in a city whose name I do not know.

sentences.ar: واشتراني تاجر غني، وأخدني لبيته، وسألني: شو بتعرف تعمل؟
sentences.en: And a rich merchant bought me, took me to his house, and asked me: what can you do?
I said: I am a merchant.
I know how to sell and buy.
He said: and can you shoot a bow?
I said: when I was young.
He said: good.
Tomorrow you come out with me.

sentences.ar: وأخدني بالصبح على غابة، على ظهر فيل.
sentences.en: And in the morning he took me to a forest, on the back of an elephant.

sentences.ar: ووقفني على شجرة عالية، وأعطاني قوس وسهام، وأكل لأيام.
sentences.en: And he stood me in a tall tree, gave me a bow and arrows, and food for days.
And he said: the elephants pass here.
When you see one, shoot it.

sentences.ar: ولما يموت، تعال قول لي، وأنا بجي بآخد عاجه.
sentences.en: And when it dies, come and tell me, and I come and take its ivory.
And he left, and left me in the tree.

sentences.ar: وقلت: من قبطان لعبد، ومن عبد لصياد فيلة.
sentences.en: And I said: from captain to slave, and from slave to elephant hunter.
Such is the world.
